registered_transitions.reason: The shell element currently adds its note role during upgrade; PR 3 owns the component-level before and after contract.
Critical, deferred, and viewport route features own explicit fallback-to-enhanced transitions that require component-state oracles in PR 3.

registered_transitions.selector: wa-badge, wa-breadcrumb, wa-breadcrumb-item, wa-button, wa-button-group, wa-callout, wa-card, wa-copy-button, wa-divider, wa-input, wa-spinner
registered_transitions.reason: Web Awesome custom elements intentionally replace authored fallback projections with component semantics; PR 3 verifies every owned state.
The diagnostic renderer label intentionally changes after the selected Web Awesome runtime is known and is asserted by its owner tests.
A successful enhanced commit intentionally populates the persistent status announcer; navigation owner tests assert its localized message.
